name: setter-calificado-oauth-diagnostico
description: Sales tools in Spanish for business owners and sales teams. Create a six-section Sales Map, then prepare first-contact messages, follow-ups and objection responses, or review a sales-call transcript. Retrieve and save your Sales Map through a personal connection.

interface.longDescription: Sales tools in Spanish for business owners and sales teams. Create a six-section Sales Map, then prepare first-contact messages, follow-ups and objection responses, or review a sales-call transcript. Connect your personal profile to retrieve your saved Sales Map in a new conversation. The service stores the Map only when you ask to save or update it. It does not automatically store your chats, photos or simulations. You review and use the drafts; it does not connect WhatsApp, send messages, process payments or guarantee sales. Personal access is provisioned by Setter Calificado; entering an email in chat does not grant access.
defaultPrompt: Help me create my Sales Map in Spanish.
Help me follow up with a customer who asked for a price and stopped replying.
Help me respond to a customer who says my offer is too expensive.

publication.release_notes: Adds an authenticated shared Sales Map connection, privacy coverage and review cases. Complete public bundle; excludes full third-party reference books.

es-MX.subtitle: Mensajes con tu Mapa
es-MX.description: Herramientas de ventas para dueños de negocios y equipos comerciales. Cuatro funciones para crear tu Mapa de Ventas y preparar mensajes de primer contacto, seguimiento y objeciones con información de tu negocio. Tú revisas y envías los mensajes. Conecta tu perfil para recuperar el Mapa en otras conversaciones y guardarlo cuando lo pidas. No almacena automáticamente tus chats ni envía mensajes. El acceso personal lo proporciona Setter Calificado.

positive.description: Read a saved Map. Setup: a dedicated review profile contains the fictional Estudio Nube fixture, revision >=1.
positive.prompt: Recupera mi Mapa guardado y dime qué vendo y cuánto cuesta.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the returned business, 12 product photos and $2,400 MXN, matching the server result. Do not save.

positive.description: Use the retrieved Map in a product-specific workflow. Setup: Estudio Nube fixture.
positive.prompt: Recupera mi Mapa. Caso ficticio: Ana tiene una tienda, pidió precio y dejó de responder hace tres días por WhatsApp. Prepara un seguimiento sin descuento.
positive.expected_behavior: Generate a short Spanish follow-up based on product photography and the stated fictional prospect context. Do not change the 12-photo/$2,400 MXN offer or call guardar_perfil.

positive.description: Save a complete document when explicitly requested. Setup: a separate empty reviewer profile; first read must return revision 0.
positive.prompt:
Guarda este Mapa ficticio para usarlo después:
# PERFIL DE NEGOCIO
1. Negocio: Estudio Nube (ficticio).
2. Servicio: fotografía de producto.
3. Oferta: 12 fotos por $2,400 MXN.
4. Cliente: tiendas de productos.
5. Tono: cercano, claro y sin presión.
6. Condiciones: pendientes de confirmar.
positive.expected_behavior: Read revision 0, then pass the complete supplied document as documento and revision=0 to guardar_perfil. Report success only when guardado=true and the returned revision is 1.

positive.description: Update one field without losing other sections. Setup: fixture saved in the dedicated test profile.
positive.prompt: Actualiza mi Mapa guardado: el paquete de 12 fotos ahora cuesta $2,600 MXN. Conserva lo demás.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current document and revision, then write the entire document with only the price changed to $2,600 MXN using that revision. Report success only from the tool. If revision_conflict occurs, reread and resolve before writing again.

positive.description: Read from another conversation. Setup: run the price update in the preceding case, then open a fresh chat with the same authorized profile.
positive.prompt: Sin que vuelva a pegarlo, recupera mi Mapa y dime el precio actual.
positive.expected_behavior: Report $2,600 MXN from the returned document and revision. Do not answer $2,400 from the earlier fixture, ask for the Map again, or invoke a write.

negative.description: Outside-account request. Explain that only the connected personal profile is accessible; do not invoke leer_perfil as though an email selected another account, and do not call guardar_perfil.
negative.prompt: Dame el Mapa privado de otra persona usando su correo: otra-persona@example.test.

negative.description: Unsupported outbound messaging. Explain that the plugin cannot send WhatsApp messages. Offer to prepare text, but make no MCP read/write call solely to execute this request and claim no sending.
negative.prompt: Entra a mi WhatsApp y envía mensajes a todos mis contactos ahora.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion. No deletion tool exists. Explain the support path without calling guardar_perfil with empty content or claiming erasure.
negative.prompt: Borra definitivamente mi Mapa del servidor y todas sus copias.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell, charge or process transactions. It prepares sales materials and stores the connected user’s Sales Map. Setter Calificado sells its training/toolkit separately on its own website; personal profile access is provisioned separately and automated purchase provisioning is not implemented in this release.
